as_told.title: Eric Davis's Frontiers of Propulsion Science on the Biefeld-Brown effect

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, reads from Frontiers of Propulsion Science, a book on ideas for moving spacecraft, citing Eric Davis and, in another episode, also crediting Marc Millis. According to Michels, Davis concedes that an Air Force study proposed that, if you assume space has five dimensions, you can derive a link between electricity and gravity that explains the Biefeld-Brown effect, a claimed push produced by high-voltage electric charge. If so, it would suggest the military once took electric control of gravity seriously.
